.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scoring.toml, tests/tools/score.py, tests/test.sh (score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the task's; scoring.toml has the same gates, weights and floor)
qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/raw-evidence-index.json (all listed artifact SHA256 values recomputed and matching) and the earlier-candidate hosted verifier/reward.json it cites
evidence:
What holds (reasoned from source, not measured on these bytes). Blank / no server: tests/test.sh:68-70 exits with the zero reward when /app/server.js is absent and :123-125 when nothing answers HTTP; a blank or error page fails gates/render cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing ('Fails if the page is blank or shows only an error, if no code editing area is shown, if the typed word does not appear in the editor'). Static shell with a textarea / contenteditable / CodeMirror: fails gates/constraints cw_custom_document_surface. Browser-only mock (localStorage library): fails cw_shared_saved_record, which clears origin storage and re-reads title, filename and source. Refusing submission: cannot complete the Save in cw_shared_saved_record. Seed copy: environment/assets/seed_data.json holds '"snippets": []' and instruction.md says 'there is no starter app to finish', so there is nothing to copy. Gates use aggregation = "all_pass" and score.py:41-48 zeroes the reward and skips the scored suite on a gate failure. Most functional criteria open with a working control (prompt.md: 'A positive control must come before every negative claim'), so always-refuse / always-error stuffing fails Run, Format, Stop, time-limit, isolation and stale-save criteria. The three scored prompts repeat the in-dimension browser gate. Hosted evidence exists only for an earlier candidate (nop reward 0; Oracle 0.9833) and says nothing about a shell that passes the gates on these bytes.

Defect 1 - the functional floor is cleared by two criteria that need neither the editor's depth nor Run. tests/scoring.toml:11 'functional = 0.05' and score.py:47 'floors_passed = scored_ran and all(scores[k] > f ...)'. The 42 functional weights sum to 58.5, so the floor is 2.925 weight units and any two 1.5-weight criteria (3.0 / 58.5 = 0.0513) pass it. Three 1.5-weight criteria are pure server CRUD plus a poll and are reachable by an app whose 'editor' only appends typed characters: cw_save_reload_restart (weight 1.5), cw_live_library_update (weight 1.5) and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (weight 1.5). Once the floor is cleared nothing ties polish or visual to working function: scored/visual/prompt.md:7 'Apart from a failed global browser gate, 0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all' and :12 'A Run that fails is not a reason to lower a visual score; judge what is on screen'; scored/polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus counts only 'controls that the app offers' ('A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here') and cw_narrow_width_usable says 'Whether Run produces the right output is scored elsewhere, not here'.

Defect 2 - keyword stuffing earns cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft. Its text (scored/functional/judge.toml, criterion cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft) requires only 'Within ten seconds and without any action in A, A must show a visible notice that a newer revision of the open snippet exists or was saved elsewhere, and A's editor must still hold exactly A's unsaved draft. Fails if no such notice appears in A, or if A's draft is replaced by B's saved source.' There is no step confirming the notice is absent before B saves, so a permanent static banner plus an app that never refreshes the open draft satisfies every listed condition. This contradicts REVIEW_POLICY 'A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing' and the functional prompt's own control rule.

Missing measurement. raw-evidence-index.json holds scripted golden checks on these bytes and a hosted run on an earlier candidate only; there is no mutated weak-app or shell run on these bytes (REVIEW_POLICY requires hash-bound reward-discrimination records). The earlier candidate's model result of 0 came from a render gate that has since been reduced to load-and-type, so it is not evidence for the current floor. The input SHA256 was preserved from the assignment, not recomputed by me.
counterexample: A good-looking mock of the playground: a styled non-editable div that appends typed characters (no caret movement, selection, undo, find, format or highlighting), title and filename fields, Run / Stop / Format buttons that only write a status line, a Node server that stores title, filename, source and a revision list in a JSON file and returns the library, a 3-second library poll, and a permanent banner reading 'A newer revision of this snippet may have been saved elsewhere'. It passes all three gate criteria (typing appears; no textarea, contenteditable or ready-made editor root; the saved record survives storage clearing and reloads). Functional: cw_save_reload_restart 1.5 + cw_live_library_update 1.5 + cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft 1.5 = 4.5 / 58.5 = 0.077, above the 0.05 floor (0.0513 even without the banner). Polish: cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus and cw_narrow_width_usable plausibly pass, 2/6 = 0.33. Visual: about 4 to 4.5 of 5 on the three likert criteria, 0.8 to 0.9. Reward = 0.6*0.077 + 0.2*0.33 + 0.2*0.85 = about 0.28 (about 0.26 without the banner) for an app that cannot run code, undo, select, find or format; roughly 85 percent of that reward is polish and visual. That is not near zero. Arithmetic is derived from the shipped weights and score.py; the judge verdicts on such an app are my prediction, not a measurement.
suggested_fix: Keep the template floor and weights untouched and change task-specific criteria only: (a) add a baseline to cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft - before B saves, A must show no newer-revision notice, and the criterion fails if the notice was already shown; (b) rebalance functional weights so no two or three storage-only criteria reach 2.925 units, for example set cw_save_reload_restart, cw_live_library_update and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft to 0.5 each or require a real editing step inside them such as an Undo-restored source before the Save, so clearing the floor needs working editor or Run behaviour; (c) measure one such shell through the configured judge on the final bytes and record the reward before claiming this row.
